lead.headline: Two Starters Questionable as Chem Chases First Win
lead.deck: Warren and Coker are both expected to play. If either sits, the replacement is already chosen — check inactives at 9:30.
lead.byline: BY THE BRIEF DESK · 02:00 MEXICO CITY
lead.body: Footballers banked 22.6 points on Thursday night, and nobody on your roster has played yet. The projections still favour you, 134.4 to 128.6, and ESPN puts it at 53%. The bad news is concentrated in the backfield: Jaylen Warren practised limited all week with a shoulder and walks into Cincinnati's league-leading pass rush, behind an offence that has scored the second-fewest points in the NFL. Jalen Coker carries the same ankle he has played through twice.

doFirst.headline: Four Moves, Soonest First
doFirst.deck: Two are today and only if someone sits. One is Tuesday and only if a condition holds. One is two weeks out and certain.

cards.headline: If Warren is inactive → start Tuten
cards.reason: Three limited practices with the shoulder; expected to play. If he's on the inactive list, Tuten takes his RB slot.

rows.label: IF ACTIVE
rows.value: Nothing to do. Warren starts; his tag this week is ELITE.

cards.headline: If Coker is inactive → start McLaurin
cards.reason: The ankle he's carried since week 1; SI calls it a surprise if he can't play.

rows.label: FALLBACK
rows.value: Terry McLaurin, 11.8 — on Mariota, but the best eligible receiver left

rows.label: IF ACTIVE
rows.value: Nothing to do. Coker starts in the flex.

cards.headline: Claim Emanuel Wilson — only if Price is out again
cards.reason: His 22 week-2 touches came after Jadarian Price left injured. If Price misses week 3 and Wilson again takes half of Seattle's carries, he's the add.

rows.label: THE DROP
rows.value: Kyle Monangai — second to Swift, on a third-string quarterback

rows.label: IF NOT
rows.value: No claim. Your waiver order resets weekly, so passing costs nothing.

cards.headline: Stream a defence for week 6
cards.reason: Achane, Jefferson, Vikings D/ST are all on bye in week 6. The bench covers two of them; nobody covers the defence.

rows.label: COVER
rows.value: Achane → Tuten; Jefferson → McLaurin; Vikings D/ST → stream
